title: Alien and Woman in Cabin
description: A woman with short black hair and purple outfit kneels on the floor of a wood-paneled living room, holding a large white and black device. A tall grey alien stands beside her wearing a large yellow M&Ms helmet filled with colorful candy. Through the large windows, a second identical alien stands near a waterfall.
prompt: A woman with short black hair wearing a blue crop top and denim shorts kneels in a retro wood-paneled living room holding a white boombox-like device, standing next to her is a tall classic grey alien with a giant yellow M&Ms helmet filled with colorful candy on its head, another identical alien stands outside near a waterfall visible through large windows, 70s interior with grey couch and wooden furniture, surreal and whimsical scene
